flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): workflows/datahiveuenfin/{services/DataHiveUenFinService,jobs/DataHiveUenFinJob} and services/datahive/nricFinUenDataRetrieval/service/DataHiveUENBatchService (UEN sync: company name and address, TS-ACR), schedulers/MhaDownloadJobsScheduler + controllers/DataHiveUenFinController (triggers), workflows/furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper (hirer becomes offender), workflows/agencies/toppan/upload (RR3 letter), cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi: CronProxyService (manual trigger from the staff portal). ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code specific to this story.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%). The hirer is at stage RR3 (3rd letter on the owner/hirer path: RD1, RD2, RR3; OCMS-DF-2026-170 names RR3 for hirers and DR3 for drivers; FurnishApprovalHelper.java:644-652 restarts a hirer at RD1). The company check exists: the UEN sync to DataHive (ACRA views) overwrites the address (mha_reg row) and the name of the company offender. Three things keep it from being complete. First, the word DOS does not appear in the repo; whether DataHive/ACRA = DOS cannot verify from repo. Second, no code detects the case 'no individual candidate / candidate is another business entity': the board data (director/partner) is deliberately not written to the DB (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1468-1476, OCMS-DEV-2026-231), so the company check runs for every company offender instead of acting as a fallback. Third, the UEN sync job is skipped by the scheduler in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:52), so it only runs through POST /datahive-uen-fin/execute-sync (also from the staff portal via CronProxyService). The synced address is only used by the letter when the mha_reg row becomes the letter_address; Toppan resets that flag after every letter with the order mha_reg, lta_reg, lta_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:394-530), so the hirer furnished_mail address is not part of that order. A company that is not found, is de-registered, or has a blank address is held with TS-ACR (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1355-1410) and gets no letter (extra logic beyond the story text). Sending the 3rd letter itself is covered in OCMS11.42. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ was not used as evidence.
recommendation: Claim partially. Company address and name are synced from DataHive, but the case 'no individual candidate' is not detected, the UEN sync job is off in prod (manual only), and DOS = DataHive is not proven. Ask URA to confirm the DOS source and whether the UEN sync must run on a schedule in prod.

steps.step: OCMS recognises the case where owner/partner/director particulars cannot be received from DOS (no individual candidate, or the candidate is another business entity)
steps.detail: No logic judges whether an individual candidate exists. storeUenDataResult stores the company detail, address and shareholders; the board data (director/partner) is not written to the DB because updateBoardInfo is commented out (OCMS-DEV-2026-231, DataHiveUenFinService.java:1468-1476), and nothing selects a person by offence date or appointment period (see OCMS11.18). So the 'no candidate' case is never distinguished; the company that is the offender is processed directly as the letter recipient.

steps.step: OCMS selects due notices whose offender is a company (hirer) at stages RD1-DR3, including RR3, for the check
steps.detail: GET_NOTICES_FOR_DATAHIVE_SQL selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= today, no suspension_type, offender_indicator = 'Y', id_type IN ('F','B'), vehicle type not I, and not in ocms_nro_temp or ocms_hst (DataHiveUenFinService.java:221-246). A furnished company hirer becomes offender Y (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:546-558) and restarts at RD1 (644-652), so it is selected once at RR3. Partial because the query does not separate hirers from owners and does not depend on the 'no candidate' case from step 1.

steps.step: OCMS sends the company UEN to the data source (DOS) and receives the latest company data
steps.detail: batchProcessUenRecords sends UEN + notice pairs to DataHiveUENBatchService.batchRetrieveUENData (ACRA company, shareholder and board views). The word DOS does not appear in the repo; whether DataHive/ACRA = DOS cannot verify from repo (same as OCMS11.17 and OCMS11.18). This job is job 2 of the MHA download scheduler, which is skipped when cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:42-44, 101-106); the value is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:51-52, comment: wait until the DataHive view names are verified). In prod it only runs through POST /datahive-uen-fin/execute-sync (DataHiveUenFinController.java:31-38), which can also be triggered from the staff portal via CronProxyService.java:234-235. Vault/DataHive connectivity per environment cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS updates the latest company address on the notice (letter destination address)
steps.detail: updateCompanyAddress overwrites block, floor, unit, street, building and postal code on the type_of_address = 'mha_reg' row of the notice offender (creating the row if missing) and only sets letter_address = 'Y' when the notice has no letter address yet (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1723-1790). A blank address is still saved and the notice gets TS-ACR (1383-1396). After every letter Toppan clears and re-sets letter_address with the order mha_reg, lta_reg, lta_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:394-410, 500-522), so the synced address is indeed what the next letter uses, but the hirer furnished_mail address is not in that order. Partial because this path only runs through the job that is not scheduled in prod (step 3), and whether real data follows that order cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS updates the latest company name on the notice
steps.detail: updateCompanyName patches the name column in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver for the notice, id_no and offender_indicator = 'Y' with the ACRA entityName (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1798-1812), called from storeUenDataResult (1410). The logic matches the story text, but it only runs through the UEN sync job that is not scheduled in prod (step 3), so Partial. The name update runs before validation; if entityName is blank, the notice gets TS-ACR 'Missing Entity Name' (1421-1426) and processing stops.

steps.step: The 3rd letter reminder (RR3) to the company hirer uses the latest address and name
steps.detail: The Toppan query for stage RR3 reads the current offender name and ID (offender_indicator = 'Y', ToppanUploadHelper maps ownerDriverName) and the address from the letter_address = 'Y' row (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:583-614), so the name and address overwritten by the UEN sync flow into the letter file. But letter generation is not scheduled: the ToppanLettersGeneratorService call in the scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), it only runs through POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-38), and the SFTP upload to Toppan is blocked by sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (application-prod.properties:86). Delivery details are in OCMS11.42.
